title: Projections onto graph planes: fixed vectors, normal estimate (Nor), angle estimate (Ang) and the inverse Lipschitz bound (Gp) with L_0 = 1/4
statement: For all n, l and every linear isometry q of R^(n+l), for continuous linear A : R^n -> R^l let G_A := q(span{graphPoint(v, A v) : v in R^n}) (the submodule Submodule.map q (span (range (v -> graphPoint v (A v))))), P_A its orthogonal projection, and P_0 the orthogonal projection onto T_0 = rotatedPlane q. Then (P1) P_A(q(graphPoint(x, A x))) = q(graphPoint(x, A x)) for every x in R^n; (P2) (Nor) |w| <= (1 + ||A||^2)^(1/2) |q(graphPoint(0, w)) - P_A q(graphPoint(0, w))| for every w in R^l; (P3) (Ang) ||A|| <= (1 + ||A||^2)^(1/2) ||P_A - P_0|| (operator norms); (P4) (Gp) for continuous linear A, B : R^n -> R^l with hsNorm A <= 1/4 and hsNorm B <= 1/4: hsNorm(A - B) <= hsNorm(P_A - P_B), where hsNorm of a linear map of R^(n+l) is taken with respect to its standard basis.
